en: A mysterious remnant of a former world far in the depths of interstellar space. Its remnants, floating in the space it once occupied, hold the resources to unlock powerful technologies. However, accessing them is not without risk...

The end! Or rather, a new beginning. Building a space platform capable of surviving this far beyond the relative safety of the crash landing site proves your capability to travel anywhere else in the great depths of interstellar space beyond. For a space platform to survive this trip, it would need to be particularly self-sufficient and have the tools needed to turn the large, dangerous asteroids along the way into usable resources.
A hot volcanic planet with mountainous volcanoes, rivers of lava, plains of ash, and sulfuric acid geysers. Rich in metals. Lava can only be crossed by elevated rail.
Get a wider range of resources from asteroids.
More advanced farming applications.
The basics of farming.
Create soil for seeding more plants.
Increases the damage of artillery.
Increased yield from asteroid crushing.
Reprocess the impurities in asteroids to get a more suitable balance of resources.
Multiply bacteria by feeding them some bioflux.
Inserted into armor to store massive amounts of energy for later.
Increase the height of layered stacks of items on transport belts.
A larger more powerful mining drill with a wider mining area. Allows the mining of harder ores, such as the harder parts of tungsten deposits.
A crafting facility for biological processes.
A combination of different plants could have a lot of uses.
Using bioflux to get chemicals in a biological way.
There appears to be a way to cultivate eggs into something...
Capturing a biter spawner and supplying it regular doses of [item=bioflux] allows biter eggs to be harvested, perhaps they could be made use of...
Use calcite to get steam, water, and heavy oil.
Hatch eggs into captive spawners and place them anywhere on Nauvis.
A robot capsule shot from a [item=rocket-launcher] injects a dose of [item=bioflux] into the spawner, capturing it. With regular doses of [item=bioflux], the spawner will remain captured.
Some plants naturally grow carbon nanotubes, which can be spun into fiber, and woven into extremely strong cloth.
A crafting facility that can handle the extreme low temperatures needed for cryogenics.
More advanced cryogenic applications.
Increases the damage of electric beams.
A crafting facility for more advanced use of magnets and electricity.
More advanced electromagnetic applications.
Turn fish into more fish.
Engineered structural foundation with heat shielding and deep screw piles. Can be placed on lava, oil ocean, and most water.
Allows more advanced smelting and other metallurgic advances.
The dense plasma focus system allows us to create energy directly from the fusion reaction without the need to use steam engines.
Inserted into armor to power other equipment.
Healthy food, healthy body.

Generates heat from chemical fuels with very high efficiency. Does not stop burning when at maximum temperature. Passes heat to connected heat pipes which can be used for steam power, or to prevent freezing.
Allows you to convert holmium ore to holmium plate.
The jellystem yields gelatinous jellynuts. Plant the seeds on jellynut soil (magenta on map).
Inserters can remove items from the unloading bay if it is attached to a cargo landing pad.
Increases the damage of laser beams.
Collect lightning from a wide area and generate power more efficiently.
Lithium is the least dense solid element, highly flammable, and difficult to store.
Increases productivity for low density structure recipes.
Be one with the machine.
Allows study beyond the basics of metallurgy.
More robust soil which allows growing plants anywhere in their biome.

A freezing wasteland with bottomless oceans of liquid ammonia that cannot be landfilled. Precarious icebergs are the closest thing to solid ground and can be extended with floating ice platform. Structures and belts will freeze if not heated by adjacent heat pipe or other hot structures, but must be placed on concrete to not melt the ice below.
A dry wind-swept planet with lightning storms on plateaus, and oceans of oil that can be bridged by elevated rails.\nThere appear to be some ruins.

A humid swampy planet with deep bogs. Wetland can support agriculture but is difficult to build on, it can be landfilled but stone is scarce.\nSnaking hills have stone and are better to build on but can't support agriculture.
A hot volcanic planet with mountainous volcanoes, rivers of lava, plains of ash, and sulfuric acid geysers. Rich in metals. Lava can only be crossed by elevated rail.
Increases productivity for plastic bar recipes.
Increases productivity for the processing unit recipe.
Used to increase research productivity, which makes it easier to research other upgrades that make future expeditions to the shattered planet easier.
A processor that exploits several quantum phenomena for various applications.
Allows building elevated rails also on the deep parts of the oil ocean on [planet=fulgora].
An electrically powered cross between a cannon and a sniper rifle.
Making railgun projectiles denser and sturdier results in more damage.
Improved cooling systems mean the railgun can shoot more often.
Increases the amount of research progress per consumed science pack.
Increases productivity for rocket fuel recipes.
Increases productivity for rocket part crafting.
Used to launch items and players to space platforms.
A long range turret that fires rockets.
Increased yield from scrap recycling.
Process asteroid chunks into useful materials.
Allows space platforms to move to other planets.
Production of [item=space-science-pack] on a space platform.
Stack inserters capable of putting items on transport belts in layered stacks, but they wait for their hand to be full until they swing.
Increases productivity for steel plate and casting steel.

The end! Or rather, a new beginning. Building a space platform capable of surviving this far beyond the relative safety of the crash landing site proves your capability to travel anywhere else in the great depths of interstellar space beyond. For a space platform to survive this trip, it would need to be particularly self-sufficient and have the tools needed to turn the large, dangerous asteroids along the way into usable resources.
Weapons that deal electrical damage and bounce between enemies.
Inserted into armor to expand your inventory.
Collect tree seeds and plant them on grass or dirt.
Allows you to make tungsten carbide, a hard heat resistant ceramic. Easily accessible tungsten ore can be found in some surface rocks of Vulcanus.
Allows you to make tungsten-steel plate.
Even faster transport belts.
The yumako tree yields tasty nutritious fruit. Plant the seeds on yumako soil (yellow on map).

Seeds planted into seedable soil grow into trees that can be harvested. [entity=agricultural-tower] automates planting seeds.
[entity=yumako-tree] can grow on [tile=natural-yumako-soil]. It produces [item=yumako] which contains [item=yumako-seed] to replant the tree.
The plantation can be extended by landfilling nearby [tile=wetland-yumako] by [item=artificial-yumako-soil]. These areas are yellow on the map.
[entity=jellystem] can grow on [tile=natural-jellynut-soil]. It produces [item=jellynut] which contains [item=jellynut-seed] to replant the tree.
The plantation can be extended by landfilling nearby [tile=wetland-jellynut] by [item=artificial-jellynut-soil]. These areas are magenta on the map.

[planet=aquilo] is a freezing wasteland with ammoniacal oceans. It is the most distant planet where the usage of [entity=solar-panel] is practically impossible.
[entity=logistic-robot] and [entity=construction-robot] are much weaker here.
The only familiar resource here is [entity=crude-oil] so the base will be dependent on planetary logistics. The player could end up stranded without enough support from other planets!
The surface is quite small and needs to be expanded. Oceans can be landfilled by [item=ice-platform] to be walkable. [item=concrete] is used as a foundation for buildings and protects the ice from melting.
Entities need to be heated to operate using [entity=heating-tower] and [entity=heat-pipe].

[entity=gun-turret] can be used to break larger asteroids into asteroid chunks. These can be picked by [entity=asteroid-collector] and processed on the platform for resources. Larger asteroids damage the platform on impact.

[planet=fulgora] is a dry barren planet with no signs of life and dangerous lightning activity in the frequent night cycles.
[entity=solar-panel] is much less effective however lightning can be collected by [entity=lightning-rod] and stored in [entity=accumulator].
There are no natural resources found anywhere on the planet. The only things available are leftovers in the form of [entity=scrap].
What might have been oceans is now full of [fluid=heavy-oil] that can be extracted by [entity=offshore-pump].
[tile=oil-ocean-shallow] isn't landfillable until much later but it can be crossed by elevated rails. Building [entity=rail-support] on deep parts of the ocean will require additional research.

[planet=gleba] is a humid swampy planet with rich exotic vegetation that can be cultivated using [entity=agricultural-tower] and processed in the [entity=biochamber].
You can't find [entity=iron-ore], [entity=copper-ore], [entity=crude-oil], [entity=coal], and [entity=uranium-ore] there but plants provide alternative ways of producing needed items.
Most of the items from agriculture come with the added challenge of spoiling over time. Even [item=agricultural-science-pack] has limited lifespan and can't be stockpiled.
Large 5-legged creatures are native species of this planet. [entity=solar-panel] is weaker but still usable.

[entity=heating-tower] can generate heat from fuel and does not stop burning when at maximum temperature.
It uses [entity=heat-pipe] to transfer heat into other entities.
Every entity needs to be touching a heat source in order to not freeze.
The exception is electric poles, [entity=solar-panel] and [entity=accumulator].

[fluid=lava] can be pumped by [entity=offshore-pump] and processed in [entity=foundry] into [item=stone], [fluid=molten-iron] and [fluid=molten-copper].\nIt is possible to remove waste items by moving them directly into [tile=lava].

[entity=lightning-rod] protects a small area from lightning strikes and converts the energy into the electric network.\nLightning generates a large amount of energy for a short period. Having more [entity=accumulator] will allow better usage of every lightning strike.\nIt can be later replaced by a more efficient [entity=lightning-collector].

[entity=space-platform-hub] can request items from the logistic network to be delivered by rockets. It is possible to auto-request missing construction materials.
[entity=rocket-silo] can be set to automatically fulfill requests from space platforms.
[entity=cargo-landing-pad] can request items from a space platform orbiting its planet, unless it is already requesting the item on this planet.
__CONTROL__stack-transfer__ in the space platform hub GUI transfers a single stack manually to planet. Items will appear in [entity=cargo-pod-container] on starting coordinates.

[entity=inserter] can be used to remove waste items by moving them into the void of space.

Space platform is built remotely, with construction materials delivered by rockets. It can be used to transport players and cargo between planets.

- [item=space-platform-starter-pack] is used to initialize platform, which is then expanded using [item=space-platform-foundation].
- [entity=asteroid-collector] catches asteroids from space for materials.
- [entity=crusher] is used to crush asteroids for resources.
In Space Age, [item=space-science-pack] can only be produced on a space platform using processed asteroid chunks.

An item with [img=utility/tooltip_category_spoilable] spoilable property has a limited lifespan. When the time expires, the item spoils into a different one, like [item=spoilage].\nAn item with higher quality stays fresh for a longer time.
[item=agricultural-science-pack] gives less value the more it is spoiled.
Spoil progress of an ingredient affects spoil progress of the product.

[planet=vulcanus] is a hot planet without [fluid=water], you can't find [entity=crude-oil] or [entity=uranium-ore] there but it contains several new [tooltip=resources,tips-and-tricks-item-description.vulcanus-resources].
[fluid=lava] is an infinite resource of minerals as a substitute for patches of [item=stone], [item=iron-ore], and [item=copper-ore]. Those can be found in raw form only in [entity=big-volcanic-rock].
[entity=solar-panel] is much more effective. The environment is inhospitable with mountainous volcanoes, rivers of lava, plains of ash, and sulfuric acid geysers.
[tile=lava] isn't landfillable until much later but it can be crossed by elevated rails.

[entity=tungsten-ore] Tungsten ore
